chunk_findings.detail: `_has_confirmed_finding` drops an entire line that contains "theoretical" or "refuted" before the severity check, so a confirmed defect on that same line is ignored. Given `roborev wait` exit 1 and body `Review for job 7: no confirmed defects.\n- medium: not refuted — the parser drops the last record`, `"no confirmed defect"` is present, the medium line is skipped, `_no_confirmed_defect` returns True, and `run` records outcome `"clean"` with an empty note. That swallows a real defect (the comment's fail-open rule says an ambiguous body must stay findings). The new tests never put a defect severity on a line that also says theoretical or refuted.
